wordmark.purpose: Lowercase "hirivo" beside the mark in the top bar.

headline.purpose: The job title on Now; one top heading per view.

title.purpose: Section headings, row names, empty-state titles. Ink, never muted.

label.purpose: Field labels, segmented options, small buttons.

value.purpose: The answer in each verdict cell; carries the state colour.

numeric.purpose: Every count and number; tabular figures.

mono-small.purpose: Host chip, kbd keys, fact tags, timeline days.

shadows.name: sheen
shadows.purpose: Top-edge highlight on raised controls in dark; none in light.

shadows.name: float
shadows.purpose: Floating layers only (light: 0 0 0 1px var(--line), 0 12px 32px -14px rgb(10 10 12 / 0.25), 0 2px 6px -2px rgb(10 10 12 / 0.08)).

shadows.name: focus
shadows.purpose: Keyboard focus ring on every control (light: jade at 45%).

shadows.name: input-focus
shadows.purpose: Halo with a jade border on focused inputs.

motion.name: t
motion.purpose: Movement: sliding indicators, view entry, chevrons, checkbox tick, badge dot.

motion.name: row-in
motion.value: 260ms; from opacity 0.2, translateY(4px); 18ms stagger, first 8 rows

motion.name: value-in
motion.purpose: Verdict values on a fresh result.

motion.name: count-up
motion.purpose: Numbers that were just measured; static when reduced motion or document.hidden.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one jade action per view state.
components.html: <button class="ds-btn ds-btn-primary"><svg class="ds-ico" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.75" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M12 8V4H8"/><rect width="16" height="12" x="4" y="8" rx="2"/><path d="M2 14h2M20 14h2M15 13v2M9 13v2"/></svg>Hand to Autopilot</button>
components.css: .ds-btn{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:6px;height:32px;padding:0 12px;font:500 13px/1 var(--font);letter-spacing:-0.005em;border-radius:var(--r-md);border:1px solid var(--line-strong);background:var(--surface-2);box-shadow:var(--sheen);color:var(--ink);cursor:pointer;transition:background var(--t-fast) var(--ease),border-color var(--t-fast) var(--ease),transform var(--t-fast) var(--ease)}.ds-ico{width:16px;height:16px;flex-shrink:0}.ds-btn-primary{background:var(--brand);border-color:transparent;color:var(--brand-ink);font-weight:600;box-shadow:inset 0 1px 0 rgb(255 255 255 / 0.18),0 1px 2px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.25)}.ds-btn-primary:hover{background:var(--brand-strong)}.ds-btn:active{transform:scale(0.98)}.ds-btn:focus-visible{outline:none;box-shadow:var(--focus)}

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Default button: surface fill, strong hairline, sheen.
components.html: <button class="ds-btn-2"><svg class="ds-ico" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.75" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M12 20h9"/><path d="M16.4 3.6a2.1 2.1 0 1 1 3 3L7 19l-4 1 1-4Z"/></svg>Write</button>
components.css: .ds-btn-2{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;height:32px;padding:0 12px;font:500 13px/1 var(--font);border-radius:var(--r-md);border:1px solid var(--line-strong);background:var(--surface-2);box-shadow:var(--sheen);color:var(--ink);cursor:pointer;transition:background var(--t-fast) var(--ease),border-color var(--t-fast) var(--ease),transform var(--t-fast) var(--ease)}.ds-btn-2:hover{background:var(--surface-3);border-color:color-mix(in srgb,var(--muted) 60%,var(--line-strong))}.ds-btn-2:active{transform:scale(0.98)}.ds-btn-2:focus-visible{outline:none;box-shadow:var(--focus)}.ds-ico{width:16px;height:16px}

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Tertiary action; no fill until hover.

components.name: Input
components.description: Field with label and hint; recessed well, jade focus.
components.css: .ds-field{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:5px;font-family:var(--font)}.ds-field>span{font-size:12px;font-weight:500;color:var(--ink-2)}.ds-field>small{font-size:11.5px;color:var(--muted)}.ds-input{font:13px var(--font);color:var(--ink);background:var(--well);border:1px solid var(--line-strong);border-radius:var(--r-md);padding:6px 10px;min-height:32px;transition:border-color var(--t-fast) var(--ease),box-shadow var(--t-fast) var(--ease)}.ds-input::placeholder{color:var(--muted)}.ds-input:hover:not(:focus){border-color:color-mix(in srgb,var(--muted) 55%,var(--line-strong))}.ds-input:focus{outline:none;border-color:var(--brand);box-shadow:0 0 0 3px var(--brand-soft)}

components.name: Verdict Strip
components.description: Four answers in one hairline-split instrument; state colour on the value only.
components.css: .ds-verdict{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr));border:1px solid var(--line-strong);border-radius:var(--r-lg);background:var(--surface);box-shadow:var(--sheen);overflow:hidden;font-family:var(--font)}.ds-cell{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:flex-start;justify-content:space-between;gap:6px;min-height:58px;padding:9px 10px 10px;border:0;background:transparent;color:var(--ink);cursor:pointer;transition:background var(--t-fast) var(--ease)}.ds-cell+.ds-cell{border-left:1px solid var(--line)}.ds-cell:hover{background:var(--hover)}.ds-cell:focus-visible{outline:none;box-shadow:var(--focus)}.ds-cell small{font-size:11px;font-weight:500;color:var(--muted)}.ds-cell b{font-size:14px;font-weight:600;line-height:1.15;letter-spacing:-0.015em}.ds-num{font-family:var(--mono);font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}.ds-cell.ok b{color:var(--brand)}.ds-cell.caution b{color:var(--caution)}.ds-cell.risk b{color:var(--risk)}

components.name: Underline Tabs
components.description: Sticky sub-navigation with one sliding 2px jade underline.
components.css: .ds-tabs{position:relative;display:grid;grid-auto-flow:column;grid-auto-columns:1fr;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);font-family:var(--font)}.ds-tabs::before{content:"";position:absolute;bottom:-1px;left:0;height:2px;width:var(--w);transform:translateX(var(--x));border-radius:2px;background:var(--brand);transition:transform var(--t) var(--ease),width var(--t) var(--ease)}.ds-tabs button{padding:11px 4px 10px;border:0;background:transparent;font-size:12.5px;font-weight:500;color:var(--muted);cursor:pointer;transition:color var(--t-fast) var(--ease)}.ds-tabs button:hover{color:var(--ink-2)}.ds-tabs button[aria-pressed="true"]{color:var(--ink)}.ds-tabs button:focus-visible{outline:none;box-shadow:var(--focus)}

components.name: Bottom Navigation
components.description: Four places, one sliding surface indicator, jade active icon, badge dots.
components.css: .ds-tabbar{position:relative;display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);padding:6px 8px 8px;border-top:1px solid var(--line);background:var(--paper);font-family:var(--font)}.ds-tabbar::before{content:"";position:absolute;top:6px;bottom:8px;left:8px;width:calc((100% - 16px)/4);border-radius:var(--r-md);background:var(--surface-2);box-shadow:var(--sheen),0 0 0 1px var(--line);transform:translateX(calc(var(--i)*100%));transition:transform var(--t) var(--ease)}.ds-tabbar button{position:relative;z-index:1;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:3px;padding:7px 0 6px;border:0;background:none;border-radius:var(--r-md);font-size:11.5px;font-weight:500;color:var(--muted);cursor:pointer;transition:color var(--t-fast) var(--ease)}.ds-tabbar svg{width:16px;height:16px;transition:transform var(--t) var(--ease)}.ds-tabbar button:hover{color:var(--ink-2)}.ds-tabbar button[aria-current="page"]{color:var(--ink)}.ds-tabbar button[aria-current="page"] svg{color:var(--brand);transform:translateY(-1px)}.ds-tabbar button:focus-visible{outline:none;box-shadow:var(--focus)}.ds-dot{position:absolute;top:5px;left:calc(50% + 7px);width:7px;height:7px;border-radius:50%;box-shadow:0 0 0 2px var(--paper)}.ds-dot.fresh{background:var(--brand)}.ds-dot.caution{background:var(--caution)}

components.name: Pill
components.description: Small status tag at 6px; tone swaps wash, border and text.
components.html: Internship Verified Due today Fee asked

components.name: Toggle Chip
components.description: Filter toggle; on state adds jade wash and a 6px dot.
components.css: .ds-chip{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:5px;height:26px;padding:0 10px;border:1px solid var(--line-strong);background:transparent;color:var(--ink-2);border-radius:var(--r-sm);font:12px var(--font);cursor:pointer;transition:background var(--t-fast) var(--ease),border-color var(--t-fast) var(--ease),color var(--t-fast) var(--ease)}.ds-chip:hover{background:var(--hover)}.ds-chip.on{border-color:var(--brand-line);background:var(--brand-soft);color:var(--ink)}.ds-chip.on::before{content:"";width:6px;height:6px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--brand)}.ds-chip:focus-visible{outline:none;box-shadow:var(--focus)}

components.name: Callout
components.description: Inline message; tone swaps to the matching wash.
components.html: Your Gmail connection expired. Reconnect to keep sending.

narrative.overview:
Hirivo's side panel is a measuring instrument, not a stack of cards. A neutral near-black ground carries three surface steps that are told apart by 1px hairlines rather than shadows; every number is set in Geist Mono with tabular figures, and colour is spent only where it carries meaning: jade for verified, primary and selected, amber for caution, coral for risk. The craft benchmark is the category standard for a dark productivity tool: Linear's calm hierarchy, Raycast's dense lists, Geist's strictness.

The panel lives at 360-420px, so density is the point. Top-level blocks run full-bleed and are split by a hairline; lists are rows with a hover fill and inset dividers, not boxes. Headings are ink, not muted labels. Motion follows one grammar (a 140ms state change, a 200ms movement, ease-out-expo), with longer reveals kept for data that has just been measured, and all of it collapses under reduced motion.

Dark is the default. The light theme is a full, independently tuned token set (deeper jade, darker amber and coral for AA on white), not an inversion. The green check mark and the lowercase "hirivo" wordmark are fixed brand assets and stay as they are. Rejected on purpose: every block boxed in a rounded, shadowed card; gradient glows; pill soup; neon-hacker styling.
keyCharacteristics: Neutral near-black ground with three surface steps and 1px hairlines; flat by default.
Geist for text, Geist Mono tabular figures for every number.
One jade primary action per view; state colour sits on values, not surfaces.
Full-bleed hairline sections and row lists instead of cards.
Lucide icons at 1.75 stroke on a two-step scale (16px / 14px).
One motion grammar: 140ms / 200ms, cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), sliding indicators, all off under reduced motion.

rules.name: The One Jade Rule
rules.body: Each view state shows one jade primary button; everything else is a secondary (surface) or ghost button. Jade elsewhere means verified or selected, never decoration.

rules.name: The Value Carries the State Rule
rules.body: In the verdict strip and the fit score, amber, coral or jade colours the value and its icon only; the cell, its label and its background stay neutral. Tinted washes appear only on elements that are themselves the message (callouts, pills, chosen chips).

rules.name: The Badge Dot Rule
rules.body: On the bottom nav, a jade dot means something new to see, an amber dot means something waiting on the user. Coral is reserved for risk and is never a dot.

rules.name: The Mono Figures Rule
rules.body: Every number on screen is Geist Mono with tabular figures, so columns of counts and scores align and read as measured.

rules.name: The Ink Heading Rule
rules.body: A section is headed by a 13.5px semibold ink title. Small muted text over a section reads as an eyebrow and is not a heading.

rules.name: The Hairline Section Rule
rules.body: A top-level block is a full-bleed section split by a 1px hairline, never a rounded, bordered card floating in the gutter.

rules.name: The Flat-by-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces never cast shadows at rest. A shadow means the element floats above the panel or has keyboard focus.

rules.name: The Two-Step Icon Rule
rules.body: Icons are 16px or 14px at 1.75 stroke, nothing else; the size follows the text they sit with.

rules.name: The Still Number Rule
rules.body: A count that cannot run must never leave a wrong value on screen. CountUp shows the real number at once when reduced motion is set or the document is hidden, and a settle timer lands it on the value if frames stop mid-count.

rules.name: The Reduced Motion Rule
rules.body: Under `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce`, every animation and transition collapses to 0.01ms with no delay. Nothing depends on motion to be understood.

dos: Do build every colour from the theme tokens and give each new token a light value tuned for AA, not an inversion.
Do split top-level blocks with a 1px hairline and run them full-bleed.
Do keep one jade primary per view state; make the rest secondary or ghost.
Do put state colour on the value and its icon, and leave labels muted.
Do set every number in Geist Mono with tabular figures.
Do use Lucide at 1.75 stroke, 16px with controls and rows, 14px with small text.
Do move things with 140ms / 200ms on cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), and slide one indicator rather than swapping highlights.
Do head sections with 13.5px semibold ink titles.
Do keep the check-mark logo and the lowercase "hirivo" wordmark exactly as they are.
donts: Don't box top-level blocks in rounded, bordered, shadowed cards.
Don't cast shadows on resting surfaces; shadows are for floating layers and focus.
Don't use gradient glows or neon accents; the only gradient is the loading shimmer.
Don't use fully rounded capsule badges; pills and chips are 6px.
Don't put small muted or uppercase labels above sections as headings.
Don't use coral for anything but risk, or a badge dot for anything but new (jade) or waiting (amber).
Don't show keyboard hints for shortcuts that don't exist.
Don't ship motion that survives reduced motion, or a counter that can rest on a wrong number.
